title: Build a bookkeeping system before you need one
summary: QuickBooks Self-Employed, Wave (free), or a well-structured spreadsheet. The trap is "I'll set it up later."
detailsHtml:
What needs to be tracked

Income by client and date. Expenses by category (the IRS Schedule C categories: advertising, car/truck, contract labor, supplies, travel, meals, home office, software, professional services, etc.). Mileage if you drive for business. Receipts retained for any expense over $75 (IRS substantiation threshold) and ideally for everything.

The home office deduction

If you have a space used regularly and exclusively for business, you can deduct a proportional share of rent/mortgage interest, utilities, insurance, and depreciation. The simplified method is $5/sq ft up to 300 sq ft ($1,500 max); the actual method requires more documentation but often produces a larger deduction. Track this from day one if applicable.
